2401.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Migrate the existing named-bot Delivery sender into its Agent Service owner using independent component baseline 527d93f15, preserving original caller behavior and canonical message identity. Main preregistration baseline is 590b0c63e. Tracks #2110, #737 and component RFC #2113. Existing RFC search found #2113; this narrow proposal records sender/config ownership and evidence without changing Store/Manager authority.

### Proposed Solution

DSMG-D1 places sender retry/direction/receipt policy and immutable bundled retry configuration under server/agent_service/delivery. Actual Bridge bootstrap loads owner settings, BotTools calls owner deliver, existing AdmissionReceiver remains the receiving boundary and durable state authority. Shared dm_beebou.delivery.messages objects remain canonical. Legacy sender remains pending supported cleanup.

Design Ideas: [Editable review v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/7c3594ac10d6a50fb1f36a27e69fb18c107ebbbd/docs/assets/feature-design/delivery-sender-migration-review-v1.pptx), [PROPOSED versioned spec](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/7c3594ac10d6a50fb1f36a27e69fb18c107ebbbd/docs/implementations/contracts/delivery-sender-migration-v1.md).

### Involved Public APIs

DSMG-C1: deliver(context, envelope, receiver, settings) -> canonical DeliveryOutcome; owner load_delivery_settings(directory=None) and frozen DeliverySettings. Existing canonical envelope/receipt identity retained. No new durable writer, tables or persisted formats.

### Test Verification

DSMG-T1 migrated sender contract vectors; DSMG-T2 config override/cancellation; DSMG-T3 actual bootstrap assembly with explicit directory/receiver stand-ins: 34 PASS on candidate c7ae8553e270a316283df60fd471c0e23e1963b5. Old suite separately 25 PASS/1 Windows timeout clock FAIL. Contracts and Bridge wheels build and install outside checkout; bootstrap/loader/BotTools/sender/canonical receipt identity and bundled config proof PASS. Full Bridge persistence/device E2E NOT_RUN. Main architecture candidate and baseline have identical four existing hive_bee_runtime findings.

### Expected Feedback Deadline

No automatic deadline; awaits affected-owner review before merge.

### CC List

Agent Service Delivery owner, BotTools owner and Bridge integration owner; no approval inferred.

### Additional Supplementary Information

Draft preregistration #2398; draft component implementation #2399. Trusted owner rows must land before source enforcement, then pending flags must be removed with source. ADR follows acceptance. No merge requested.

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

## 阶段一　第一笔搬迁与新首页主链

### User scenario
HostAPI must read the original admitted authorization/tool/path/target/credential/budget envelope after restart without reconstructing it from a changed profile.

### Design Ideas
Refs #2113; AS-I18 item 3 and migration ledger row 27. This slice supplies an unassembled owner-local adapter and tests only. No Store writer, shared contract change, persisted schema or production assembly. Existing Host RunMandateSource remains unchanged. Design/contract owner review remains required before production activation.

### Routing and ownership
Baseline component/agent-service 85ea5889e1177a7d900141981a443166fb236d3a. HostAPI consumes RunMandateSource.mandate(claim, selection). Store remains sole admission writer; its mandate snapshot writer/read contract is missing. Touch Host-local mandate_source.py, tests and evidence only.

### Involved Public APIs
Existing RunMandateSource, RunClaim, RunSelection, ClaimCheck. Local snapshot reader proposal is not a published Store port.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules
Session Store/profile owners must define admission snapshot capture, immutable version, current scope/revocation semantics and authenticated atomic read. No live wiring in this task.

### Test Design and Test Plan
RMS-T1 retained envelope and restart/profile drift; T2 full claim/scope mismatch; T3 revocation/unknown without cache; T4 missing/invalid closed; T5 tool ceiling. Existing approval suites compared at exact baseline/head. Production Store recovery validation BLOCKED until actual writer and read port exist.

### Background and Goal Description

关联 #2116、#2167、#759。v3.1 拆分 Bridge 后，部署入口统一进入 Server Runtime。需要先确定四个组件怎样接收启动配置、怎样交出启动期间生成的公开接口，以及 Runtime 按什么顺序把上游输出交给下游。提案经签收后，Agent Service、Mobile Gateway、Model Gateway、Plugin Gateway 各自修改本组件的公开配合层。

本文是待评审的跨组件契约。编号以 [Boot v1 版本化规范](https://github.com/Evelynn-V/DigitalMate/blob/be58d58dfda1dc85c6bd399f4fe2b2840f007df6/docs/implementations/contracts/server-runtime-boot-v1.md) 为准。现有生命周期行为以 [Runtime v0.3 公开协议](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/server/server_runtime/ports.py) 和 [ADR-0037](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/adrs/0037-server-runtime-owner-port-assembly.md) 为基线。

### Proposed Solution

#### BOOT-C1～C4 · 部署输入、Boot、配置读取和工厂

- **BOOT-C1（部署 → Boot）**：部署提供启动配置引用。v1 的监听地址与停机预算从配置读取，暂不提供命令行覆盖。
- **BOOT-C2（Boot → Runtime）**：同步 Boot 接收配置引用、受信任的预绑定工厂和停机通知。装配完成后委托已有的异步 `serve()` 顺序协调启停。
- **BOOT-C3（Runtime → 配置读取器）**：`read_config(deployment_ref) -> (snapshot_id, document)` 只读取一次。默认读取器以原始 TOML 内容的 SHA-256 标识快照。Boot 路径中，`prepare(config_ref=快照 ID)` 收到的是快照 ID。工厂绑定本段配置和 ID，组件准备时核对 ID 后使用绑定配置。ID 不匹配则拒绝，准备阶段无需再次读取部署文件。现有低层调用按原契约迁移。
- **BOOT-C4（Runtime → 工厂）**：装配方可以提供位于 `server/` 外的已登记、预绑定工厂。Harness 装配、认证、作用域查询由受信任的装配方绑定。Runtime 调用 `create(FactoryInput)`。其中 `config` 为本组件只读配置，`snapshot_id` 为同一快照 ID。工厂由部署入口代码显式绑定；配置仅控制可选组件和各 owner 设置，不加载模块或 callable。
- **唯一能力规则**：启动快照 `[capabilities]` 是能力到必需 Gateway 的唯一来源。Runtime 将同一份只读映射交给 Agent、Mobile 工厂。Agent 使用该映射派生 Gateway 依赖状态，并报告自身实际业务状态。迁移期若 Agent 保留旧规则且与该输入不一致，Agent 应拒绝准备。真实 Agent 的实现和验收由 owner 签收。

#### BOOT-C5～C8 · 四个组件的参数和输出

| 组件 | 工厂输入与归属 | Runtime 调用的 `prepare` | `prepare` 结果 | 启动、状态与关闭 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BOOT-C5 · Model Gateway | `[model]` → owner 定义的 `ModelConfig` | `prepare(config_ref=快照 ID)` | 已准备句柄，公开 `dispatch_port` 提供模型派发 | `start()`、`status()`、`stop(deadline) → StopReport` |
| BOOT-C6 · Plugin Gateway | `[plugin]` → owner 定义的 `PluginConfig` | `prepare(config_ref=快照 ID)` | 已准备句柄，公开 `dispatch_port` 提供工具派发 | `start()`、`status()`、`stop(deadline) → StopReport` |
| BOOT-C7 · Agent Service | `[agent]` → owner 定义的 `AgentConfig` | `prepare(config_ref=快照 ID, address=..., events=..., model=..., plugins=...)` | 已准备句柄，公开 `requests` 提供业务请求入口 | `start()`、`status(capability) → AgentStatus`、`stop(deadline) → StopReport` |
| BOOT-C8 · Mobile Gateway | `[mobile]` → owner 定义的 `MobileConfig` | `prepare(address=..., requests=..., readiness=...)`；组件对象提前提供 `events` | 已准备传输句柄 | `start(listener)`、`ready()`、`stop_accepting(deadline)`、`close(deadline)` |

配置类名是示意，字段和发布位置由各 owner 签收。共享生命周期状态类型以 `server/server_runtime/ports.py` 为唯一来源。Model、Plugin 可由配置省略，Agent Service 的对应参数为 `None`。能力要求的 Gateway 未选中时，Runtime 应在绑定监听或准备组件前拒绝启动。

#### BOOT-S1～S3 · 启动、失败和停机流程

1. Runtime 绑定对外监听 socket，产生实际 `BoundAddress`。Agent 的 `address` 暂保留为兼容的对外回调地址。Agent 自有的回环模型中继由 Agent 在 `start` 绑定、在 `stop` 释放。
2. 所选 Model / Plugin Gateway 的 `prepare` 返回公开派发口。Runtime 取 Mobile Gateway 的 `events`，把地址、事件口和已选派发口交给 Agent Service。
3. Runtime 把 Agent Service 返回的 `requests`、实际地址和只读就绪查询交给 Mobile Gateway。
4. 按 Model → Plugin → Agent → Mobile 启动已选组件。Mobile Gateway 的 `start(listener)` 使用 Runtime 借出的 socket。Mobile 完成 `prepare` 后即可接收 Agent `start` 期间的重放。补读接口尚未开放时，Mobile 返回 `UNAVAILABLE`，Agent 保留发布义务。
5. 停机先停止接入并关闭监听，再等 Agent Service 收束。Agent Service 确认停止且无仍在使用的资源后，Runtime 才关闭传输和 Provider Gateway。准备阶段未返回句柄前失败，由提供方回收已取得的资源。

**配置快照和运行时输出是两类值。** 例如 Model Gateway 的 `dispatch_port` 是可调用接口。若跨进程实现需要实际 TCP 地址，提供方在绑定之后通过签收的类型明确交付，Runtime 直接传给使用方。TCP 地址和派发接口均无需写回配置。每条依赖同时声明「什么时候能取得」和「什么时候能调用」。如果下游在 `prepare` 阶段就需要调用已在线的上游，先评估能否把调用移到 `start`。确实需要提前联网时，由双方与 Runtime 一起评审阶段顺序与失败回收。

### Involved Public APIs

Runtime owner 的候选公开符号如下。组件生命周期沿用现有 `ports.py` 签名。

- `server.server_runtime.runtime.boot(config_ref, *, agent_factory, mobile_factory, model_factory=None, plugin_factory=None, wait_for_shutdown, config_read=read_config) -> StopReport`。`wait_for_shutdown` 是返回 awaitable 的无参函数。
- `server.server_runtime.runtime.ConfigRead` 与 `read_config`。读取器接受部署引用并返回 `(snapshot_id, document)`，当前没有独立的 `ConfigSnapshot` 类型。
- `server.server_runtime.ports.FactoryInput(snapshot_id, config, required_by_capability)`。Agent、Mobile 收到同一份只读能力依赖表。Model、Plugin 的该字段为 `None`。
- `server.server_runtime.runtime.serve` 是现有异步协调器。计划中的 `server/__main__.py` 由 Runtime 和部署 owner 确认正式装配与退出策略。

请各 owner 按下表签收。

| 项目 | 回复内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 工厂与配置 | 公开符号、配置类型、必填项、默认值、校验规则、配置版本 |
| 输入和输出 | 方法签名、公开参数类型、返回类型、上游提供方和下游消费方 |
| 阶段约束 | 输出最早可取得、最早可调用、下游最晚何时需要，是否依赖上游已在线 |
| 失败与所有权 | 资源归属、缺失或超时结果、部分失败回收责任、重复关闭语义 |
| 交付证据 | 实现 PR、最小契约 ST、使用的真实组件及替身 |

### Test Verification

统一使用版本化规范中的验收编号。

- **BOOT-T1 · Runtime / 部署**：从正式制品入口加载工厂。候选先验证单次读取、文件被替换后仍用原快照、以及缺必需 Gateway 和显式禁用 Agent 时提前拒绝。
- **BOOT-T2 · Model Gateway**：用真实 Model Gateway 和受控上游验证启停、派发和资源释放。
- **BOOT-T3 · Plugin Gateway**：用真实 Plugin Gateway 验证可选未启用、派发和未收束。
- **BOOT-T4 · Agent Service**：用真实 Agent 验证 Profile、请求、事件和停机。候选替身覆盖旧能力规则冲突导致启动拒绝。
- **BOOT-T5 · Mobile Gateway**：用真实 Gateway 验证 HTTP/WS、本沙箱业务 scope 和停接后交付收尾事件；鉴权与路由由 ADX 提供并单独取证。
- **BOOT-T6 · 独立验收**：经 ADX 已鉴权并正确路由的沙箱入口，从正式制品跑通消息、回复与关闭。

### Additional Supplementary Information

四个组件请先签收配置输入、运行时依赖和生命周期输出，再各自提交实现。生产启用继续遵循 ADR-0037 和 #2116 的验收条件。已有无 Bridge 的替身系统测试见 #2391，作为联调起点。

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Bee Run 在一次委派之后进入 **无法收敛** 的状态：Beebou 已经给出可见回复，随后 reconcile 循环不断打印 `no isolation witness`，**不再有任何模型调用**，整题永远不返回，只能等外部 deadline 把它杀掉。

这不是"慢"，是死锁：两处复现里，卡死之后模型调用数都是 **0**。

**两处独立复现（同一适配器版本，不同 benchmark）**

| # | 场景 | 卡死时刻（最后一次模型调用） | 卡死后模型调用 | 结束方式 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PAST-Bench 族 `SM01_preference_adoption`，第 4 个 episode | 10:04:42 | 0（20 条 orphan 日志） | 人工终止（约 10:13） |
| 2 | pi-bench persona `pharmacist`，第 1 题 `pharmacist_task_001` | 15:53:27 | 0（24 条 orphan 日志） | 适配器单题 1800s 上限 → `DigitalMate task deadline exceeded` → `NonZeroAgentExitCodeError` |

两次的共同点：卡死前最后一条事件都是 **Beebou 的可见回复**（复现 1 是 204 字符，复现 2 是 14 字符），紧接着就是 reconciliation 失败并进入循环。

**两条不同的诊断信息（原文）**

复现 1（PAST-Bench）：

```
Bee run run_6606691d22df4c539232d0dcce3f1c87 (task task_fe7fbc0f554045c696d717187e9a9a2d, source_seq None)
has no isolation witness: the adapter is not the owned, ready, ask-only Bee runtime;
the claim stays RUNNING until reconciled
```

复现 2（pi-bench）：

```
Bee execution requires reconciliation
Bee run run_814517e61fb445198ff835d3d9d17fc6 (task task_c5ddc553d57347518234221dc91ab5af, turn run)
is orphaned but has no isolation witness: the same runtime instance holds the Run and its turn
named no runtime request; it stays RUNNING
```

第一条指向的是 **适配器本身不被认作 owned / ready / ask-only 的 Bee runtime**。结合 #1681 里 F1 isolation witness 的契约（Run 只有在拿到 runtime 的新鲜证明、或证明该 runtime 已消失时才结算，否则保持 `RUNNING`），当适配器永远给不出证明时，这个 Run **理论上就不可能结算**——reconcile 会一直循环下去。第二条是 #1885 里同一现象（同一 runtime 实例持有 Run，但 turn 没有 runtime request）。

**影响**

1. 任何把任务委派给 Bee 的长任务都可能永久挂住，而宿主侧无法区分"挂死"和"在思考"；
2. 评测侧只能靠外部超时兜底：pi-bench 白烧 34 分钟并整条 persona 判失败；PAST-Bench 整族 8 个 episode 的结果全部作废；
3. 这个状态还会污染后续：Run 停在 `RUNNING`，同一 lane 后续输入无法被消费。

**建议动作**

1. **给 reconcile 一个有界策略**：同一 Run 连续 N 次（或 T 秒）拿不到 witness 就把它终结为 `FAILED`，并输出一次终态诊断，而不是无限重试；
2. **适配器不可见证时明确降级**：如果适配器结构上无法提供 witness（例如 MCP 补丁适配器），在进入时就记录一次原因并把 Run 标为 `FAILED`，不要进入 claim 循环；
3. **让 MCP 补丁适配器被识别为 owned runtime**——复现 1 的 `the adapter is not the owned, ready, ask-only Bee runtime` 看起来是根因，值得单独确认；
4. 当"同一 runtime 实例持有 Run"时，尽量把 `turn named no runtime request` 解析到该实例上，而不是直接判定为无法见证（复现 2 / #1885）；
5. 日志里带上 `run_id` / `task_id` / 重试计数，便于宿主侧定位（现在只能靠行数推断）。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

| 项目 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 产品版本 | DigitalMate `c0591ca421784c283fe6ea1b38364abc739c8115`（PR #699 workspace 候选） |
| 补丁 | 本地 Host MCP patch `6ec6d4ce77fcde00d0ddf16a04371e4554151df3f4e2979296beebc6a797d522` |
| 适配器 | ACP + MCP（`hive_acp.py` → `hive_run.py --session`），一个 session 一个隔离实例 |
| 模型 | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017（OpenAI 兼容端点） |
| 评测框架 | Nullius standard，container backend，每 unit 一个容器 |
| 复现 1 | `past-dm-smoke-1123-1001`，PAST-Bench `past-bench-smoke`（SM01，8 episodes） |
| 复现 2 | `pibench-dm-rest-1123-1546 / pharmacist__u0002`，pi-bench `pi-bench-marketer→pharmacist` |

**如何复现**

两次都是标准调用，没有特殊开关：

```bash
# 复现 2：pi-bench，一个 persona
nullius standard run pi-bench digitalmate@hive-mcp-local \
  --dataset pi-bench-pharmacist --model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --provider custom --backend container -j 1 \
  --simulator-model <judge> --judge-model <judge> \
  --timeout agent=21600

# 复现 1：PAST-Bench，一个族
nullius standard run past-bench digitalmate@hive-mcp-local \
  --dataset past-bench-smoke --model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --provider custom --backend container -j 1 --judge-model <judge>
```

**可提供的证据**：两份完整 `agent.log`（含 `at_ms` 时间线、orphan 行）、trial 目录结构、以及同一 persona 上"正常跑完"的对照（`marketer` 64 分钟 20 题、COMP 0.653，说明并非所有任务都会触发）。

相关：#1885（同一 `no runtime request` 现象，P1）、#1681（F1 isolation witness 的结算契约）。

### 🚀 Background Description

认领 #2113 Phase 4 的 Runtime 与 Agent Service 生命周期接线。Refs #2113、#2167、#759。基于组件分支 9cd235880，复用已合入的 #2335。目标是提供默认部署可保持原有入口、受信任装配方可显式启用的联调入口。

### 🚀 Background Description

Refs #2113, #2199, #2210 and #2426. Phase 2 B must carry each original queued message to quick and second_quick with its two immutable admission references. This work package tracks the production entry through restart and publication.

### Design Ideas

[Editable Side Run queue recovery design v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e0e638ddbc58ffb7020f50fc437270024b02438b/docs/assets/feature-design/agent-service-side-queue-review-v1.pptx). Store/Manager accepted the bounded SQR-D1–D3 design in [the v1 verdict](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2464#issuecomment-7098520034); implementation merged in #2468. The production work package remains open.

Design draft: [AS-I21 and AS-I37](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/268cf074c64d593e7102eb19616b6dcea3133eeb/docs/implementations/modules/agent-service/agent-service-implementation-decisions.md), [Side Run contracts](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/268cf074c64d593e7102eb19616b6dcea3133eeb/docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-backend-side-runs-v3.1.md), and the [proposed Manager admission materials (AC v1)](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2210). [Final race and queue decisions](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7093817861).

Queue writer → original SQLite write plus per-kind binding/reference → commit → Backend side runner → Manager/Store check original claim and selection → durable B1 → side-specific settle_quick_reply or submit_silent_terminal → same-transaction verification of claim, Stop, effects and consumption → eligible terminal/turn/obligation → read_unpublished at startup, deliver to Gateway, then mark_published on acknowledgment. A claimed normal input yields late; retirement, generation drift or a moved watermark yields skipped. Both durably end the claim without a context turn or a publication. The blocker ending or stopping alone leaves quick eligible.

### Involved Public APIs

Keep the existing Backend and Gateway contracts. Original queue reconciliation belongs to Session Store. Enable OwnerModules.side_runs only with all transaction participants on a future owner-approved unified Store migration.

The normal Run uses `submit_terminal`. The side settlement ports above own side dispositions. `SQLiteQuestionPublications` supplies the DMS1 `read_unpublished` / `mark_published` boundary. Session Store/publication-owner sign-off on that contract for the unified profile is pending. The reference participant uses its existing `queue_ddl` and `SIDE_RUN_DDL` only after the unified migration is allocated. As of component `e0e638ddbc58ffb7020f50fc437270024b02438b`, that migration and its same-connection original-input/Workspace M1 issuer have no merged SHA. Session Store / Manager own the queue and B1 inputs. Workspace and Session Store own the original-claim mapping and atomic terminal/turn/journal transaction. See the [owner requirements in #2113](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7097699942), #2474 (queue owner proposal), #2439 (claim recovery) and #2448 (terminal proposal). The formal opener is disabled.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Store/Manager and Delivery own durable input, authority, authorization and terminal effects. Backend starts the original Run and replays durable events. The Workspace terminal and publication writers need one write transaction.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Exercise initial enqueue and both side kinds, rollback and lost ACK, original-profile readback before B1, cross-scope aliases, both writer orders, Stop isolation, uncertain B1 and restart scanning. Record separately which edges use real owners and any remaining substitutes. Keep this issue open until both production-owner paths pass on the component branch.


At PR head `fee2b2e761b88877ca89aa80217be720fa9393ca`, use Python 3.12 with project dependencies. From the checkout, under zsh:

```zsh
paths=("$PWD" "$PWD/tests/server" "$PWD/tests" "$PWD/plugins/beebou/src" "$PWD/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src" "$PWD"/temp/*/src)
export PYTHONPATH="${(j.:.)paths}"
python3.12 -m pytest -q tests/server/agent_service/session_manager/test_side_runs.py tests/server/agent_service/test_sqlite_question_cards.py
```

| ID and test | Real participants | Controlled input or missing owner | Expected result and status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SQR-T1, `SideOwnerTest.test_reopen_after_lost_enqueue_ack_reads_original_pair_and_bindings` and `test_second_reference_failure_rolls_back_the_queue_and_first_reference` | Independent SQLite file connections and SQLiteSideRunStore | Original-input producer | PASS. Commit exposes both bindings and references; rollback exposes neither; reopening uses the original even after the current binding changes. |
| SQR-T2, `SideOwnerTest.test_quick_commits_while_normal_waits_for_the_same_writer`, `test_normal_claim_commits_while_quick_waits_for_writer`, `test_stale_claim_stop_and_unknown_evidence`, `test_scope_and_authorization_precede_disclosure` | SQLite writer locking, SessionSideRuns, Store | Window/Stop/authorization/effect evidence | PASS. Each ordering yields one durable disposition; normal first is late. Stale, stopped or foreign claims cannot produce a publication. |
| SQR-T2, `SideOwnerTest.test_recovered_queue_pair_reaches_both_backend_terminal_ports_once` | Reopen queue pair, real Backend entry and side terminal coordination, Manager and SQLite Store | Harness/Host, model and M1 participants | PASS. One accepted quick obligation and a silent secondary result. Re-delivery starts neither a second execution nor an obligation. |
| SQR-T3, `DurableCardTests.test_backend_cold_scan_replays_a_retained_terminal_and_marks_its_sequence` | DMS1 SQLite journal/read/mark and Backend startup scanner | M1 journal row, authorization and Gateway | PASS. Previously empty scanner publishes the retained sequence once on restart and zero after the durable mark. |
| Production quick from original existing-session enqueue through M1, abrupt restart, startup scan and ACK | Real queue/Manager/Side Store/B1/Workspace M1/Backend/publication required | Unified schema, scoped input issuer and Workspace claim lineage pending | BLOCKED. Require one durable turn and one obligation, then one original delivery after restart and zero on the next scan. |
| Production second_quick through original existing-session enqueue, silent terminal and new-process scan | Same production owners | Same missing transaction and issuer | BLOCKED. Require the original side receipt and no context turn or obligation on either scan. Deployment and shared devices NOT_RUN. |

### 📚 Documentation Issue Description

契约模板 [contract-template.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/contracts/contract-template.md) §2 规则要求：

> 方法参数一律仅限关键字（`*` 之后），不设默认值，除非默认值本身是契约的一部分。

但 #2183 合入的三份 owner-port 契约的 §2 签名块使用位置参数：

- [Delivery owner ports](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-delivery-owner-ports-target.md)：`def deliver(self, request: DeliveryRequest) -> DeliveryResult: ...`
- [Session Manager backend ports](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-session-manager-backend-ports-target.md)：`async def submit_terminal(self, request: TerminalRequest) -> TerminalObservation: ...`
- [Session Store owner ports](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-session-store-owner-ports-target.md)：同一签名块内混用——`def claim_run(self, request: ClaimRunRequest)` 为位置参数，而 `async def check_claim(self, *, claim: RunClaim)` 为仅限关键字。

影响：

1. 按模板定义，`AGREED` 要求提供方与全部调用方确认签名；签名块不合模板时，三份契约不具备进入 `AGREED` 的条件。
2. #2183 正文已注明 "Any future change to positional versus keyword-only calls needs consumer review"，但该未决项没有独立跟踪。Phase 2 实现 issue（如 #2197、#2203、#2204、#2206、#2208、#2210、#2216）声明"按契约现文实现"，位置调用一旦落码，后续切换成本按"改签名先改契约 + 通知全部调用方"放大。
3. 调用方若按 §6 提前写替身，需要先知道调用约定；现状未在契约正文显式声明。

### Improvement and Fix Suggestions

建议在实现启动前二选一并显式记录：

- **方案 A（对齐模板）**：三份契约统一改为 `def method(self, *, request: XxxRequest)`，同步更新 §5 用例与 §6 替身写法，通知"调用方"栏列出的各方，并在 §8 变更记录注明。
- **方案 B（修订模板）**：若"单个冻结请求对象 + 位置调用"是有意选择（便于替身与 mock），修订模板 §2 允许该变体，并要求每份契约在 §2 显式声明调用约定与偏离理由，§8 留痕。

建议同批裁决调用模式一致性：Manager 块为 `async`，Delivery/Store 块为同步，二者直接决定替身写法，宜一并确认。

### Version Information

- main：`7743b6857`（2026-11-23）
- #2183 文档基线：`52f71d34acbaf242044a1b4f7e9596272ff041f6`；最新候选：`0dc9a495f9779699e2817fb879db2411e03b24fa`
- 涉及文件：`contract-template.md`、上述三份 `*-target.md`

2476.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Refs #2110, #2438, #2224 and #2280. This is a follow-up to Model Gateway #2281, Agent Service #2432 and Runtime Boot #2391.

At main `dd24a9f8`, [Model Gateway's prepared handle](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/dd24a9f8eb29f3b2d9e86a6ba356d547e35a617c/server/model_gateway/main.py#L65) exposes both `dispatch_port` and `binding_settings`, but [Runtime](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/dd24a9f8eb29f3b2d9e86a6ba356d547e35a617c/server/server_runtime/runtime.py#L192) only passes the dispatch port. On `component/agent-service` at `c8ca87f0`, [AgentService.prepare](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c8ca87f0d2fee56f7dd494a6541a8284a6d5c918/server/agent_service/main.py#L1588) obtains `Assembly.model_gateway_config` during preparation. It does not accept #2391's candidate `model_binding_settings` keyword. The current Runtime candidate and real Agent Service cannot use that keyword together today.

### Design Ideas

Propose that Runtime take `dispatch_port` and read-only `binding_settings` from **the same prepared Model Gateway handle** and pass both to Agent at `prepare`. Agent binds the incoming settings to the existing exact-`ProviderBinding` consumption and validation path, including stream support and the output-token cap. Model calls continue to use the Host-issued dispatch interface after Model start.

Keep a single authority for Model settings on the new Boot path. Agree how to reject a conflicting legacy Assembly value and how to handle an optional Model that is not selected. Require exact bindings for the selected startup profiles and reject an unknown binding at request time without resolving it to a same-name or latest binding.

### Involved Public APIs

- Producer: `PreparedModelGateway.dispatch_port` and `binding_settings: Mapping[ProviderBinding, ModelBindingSettings]`.
- Candidate consumer: `AgentServicePort.prepare(..., model=..., model_binding_settings=...)` and the matching Agent Service implementation. Runtime, Agent Service and Model Gateway owners should sign off the exact signature, optional behavior, and rejection rules before adoption.
- Existing consumer: `Assembly.model_gateway_config`. Reuse its interpretation and validation of exact binding settings, with an explicit transition for existing callers.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Runtime coordinates the handoff, Model Gateway owns the setting values, and Agent Service owns their interpretation and use in Host and Harness. Mobile/Plugin lifecycle sequencing stays on the existing v0.3 contract. Track legacy `post_json` caller migration separately.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Use the real Boot entry with the real Model and Agent owners at fixed revisions, a controlled Mobile peer and a loopback model upstream.
- Verify prepare receives the dispatch port and settings from the same handle, Agent applies the exact binding settings, and one Host-authorized request reaches the gateway after start.
- Add counterexamples for a missing required binding, a same-name binding from another snapshot, a conflicting legacy setting, and an unselected optional Model.
- Verify startup failure cleanup and normal ordered shutdown. Record component revisions, real participants and substitutes. Installed image and production acceptance retain their separate #2116 scope.

### Additional Information

Owner coordination requested: Agent Service, Server Runtime, Model Gateway. This issue tracks the real handoff and its test evidence. #2391 currently verifies the candidate with substitutes.

2483.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

An operator who runs one isolated Hive Home instance per user or per job has no way to give that instance's Bees the operator's own MCP servers. `server_engine.engine_tools_mcp.mcp_servers()` lists only the product's built-in server, and the Bee tool catalog has no connector for others.

This blocks headless use where the tools come from outside: for example an evaluation harness that hands each session a stdio MCP server (as ACP clients do with `session/new` `mcpServers`). On v0.1.13 such a session cannot reach any of the given tools, so the task fails, whatever the model.

Related: #835 (configured MCP discovery and bound tool invocation), #1646 (Bees discovering tools within Host authorization), #1797 (tool access base).

### Design Ideas

Design of record (architecture change review, lane A, PROPOSED): [review deck v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9b210365c7b4a392f905f36374e56f64eee6e766/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-session-mcp-review-v1.pptx) and [specification hive-session-mcp-v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9b210365c7b4a392f905f36374e56f64eee6e766/docs/implementations/contracts/hive-session-mcp-v1.md), at PR #2484 head `9b210365c`. RFC: #2115 via #835 (DM31-M45); this is a `temp/hive-tools` transition retired when #835 lands (HSM-D9).

A Host-granted stdio MCP connector owned by the Hive tools package:

- The operator sets `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_MCP_SERVERS` to an operator-owned JSON file (mode 0600, outside the agent workspace): `{"cwd": "/abs/dir", "servers": [{"name", "command", "args", "env"}]}`. Only stdio; at most 16 servers; never built from model output.
- `dm_hive_tools.session_mcp.SessionMcp` owns the connections, configuration validation and scope (the Host's principal and room). Servers start once before Hive accepts turns and are closed with the Bee runtime.
- Two catalog tools, Bee-only and Host-listed: `list_mcp_tools` and `call_mcp_tool`. Calls go through the existing Host effect gate and effect receipts; no new store.
- Without the setting nothing changes: the two tools are not offered (#1790 B16).
- Transport loss or a timeout after dispatch is an uncertain effect, never a success or a definite refusal; the existing receipt prevents replaying it.

### Involved Public APIs

- New environment setting `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_MCP_SERVERS` (optional; HSM-C1), grant file schema (HSM-C2), limits file `dm_hive_tools/config/session_mcp.toml` (HSM-C4).
- Two new Bee catalog tools `list_mcp_tools`, `call_mcp_tool` (only when configured).
- No change to the Gateway protocol or the Bridge's public methods.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `server_engine/server.py`: builds the connector from the setting, starts it with the other startup steps, closes it with the Bee runtime.
- `server_engine/hive_bee_runtime.py` and `server_engine/hive_bee_tools.py` (`plugin_tool_refs`): register its tools with the Bee's plugin tools.
- `server.py` `_prepare_bee_prewarm`: the setting is an assembly grant, so no prewarmed Bee (HSM-D5).
- `temp/hive-tools/ownership.json` (component `hive-tools-session-mcp`, adapter public `plugin_tool_refs`); packaged by the Bridge wheel's existing `dm_hive_tools` force-include.
- `temp/hive-tools`: connector, handlers, catalog rows, ownership.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- `temp/hive-tools/tests/test_hive_tools_session_mcp.py` against a real stdio MCP fixture and the production connector and effect provider: discovery, retained server state, tool errors, credential environment isolation, scope, configuration change and revocation, cancellation, transport uncertainty, receipt replay, no tools without a grant.
- Catalog and rail policy tests updated for the two tools and for their absence without configuration.
- End to end: a Hive Home instance given one stdio MCP server through the setting, a Bee asked to use its tools (a no-argument tool, typed arguments, the right tool among decoys, a chain of three calls, a refused call corrected).

### Additional Information

A pull request follows from a fork.

### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest inspected release branch.
- [x] Environment and a controlled real-caller reproduction are included below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
When scoped Gateway model configuration supplies an internal HTTP API_BASE, Bridge loads it through the privacy owner and publishes it to EngineConfiguration.bound. A Feishu scan then receives application credentials, but Registry credential saving calls EngineConfiguration.prepare. Its combined settings validation excludes process-environment operator values and fails to exclude the equivalent bound model fields. It rejects the unchanged platform HTTP endpoint before privacy stage, so the second personal-account authorization is never requested.

A controlled reproduction through real scan_start → Registry → Configuration → temporary SQLite fails after 4.216 ms with ValueError at configuration validation and no stage call. The identical synthetic endpoint supplied in process_environment succeeds through stage/commit and reaches the second link. A separate real-account test1 process-environment flow also completed; it is a control, not repaired test0 acceptance. Historical test0 exception was not directly captured.

### Detailed Environment Information Description
DigitalMate HarmonyOS 0.1.13 (10126), server privacy storage, Gateway scoped remote model configuration, internal HTTP LiteLLM endpoint. Providers in the regression are controlled; owner persistence and caller are real temporary files/SQLite. No credentials or user records are attached.

### Version Information

2491.author: Jianyu010
2491.body:
Delivery's AS-C2 `MobileASProxy.read_run_events` (Mobile Gateway reads missed durable events back after a disconnect) needs Backend to turn Store's `Publication` rows into `RunEvent`s. Delivery must not copy Backend's private decoder or assign `sequence` itself. The Session Store and Delivery owner asked for this on #2113.

Scope (Backend, dev A):
- `FinalCoordinator.events_from_publications(*, identity, publications) -> tuple[RunEvent, ...]`, named by the Protocol `RunEventCodec`.
- The same decoding and AS-C3 check as `publish_unpublished`. Store's `durable_sequence`, the Run identity and the terminal answer are kept unchanged.
- The whole batch is checked first. One bad row (another Run, a kind that is not durable, undecodable, breaks AS-C3) raises `PublicationDecodeFailed` and takes no `sequence`; Delivery maps it to `UNAVAILABLE`.
- No publish, mark or hold, and no settlement.
- `sequence` continues the live counter of a held Run. An ended Run is numbered from 1 and leaves no state.

Out of scope: Delivery's `read_run_events` itself, which belongs to dev B (authorization, Run check, `read_publications`, continuity and pagination).

Refs #2113
